name: Reeve Halda
text: The reeve keeps the peace in Westhold, and pays those who help her keep it.

name: Factor Imre
text: A trader with business all along the border, and never enough couriers.

name: Warden Osk
text: The old hill warden watches the passes for trouble.

name: Ysolde the Necromancer
text: She keeps the crypt under the old chapel, and she can call the dead back up out of it, for a price or a service.

name: Brother Aldo
text: A grey-robed priest of the god of death. His mortuary can send the dead back, if the god is paid, in crowns or in service.
